last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 41
last_episode_to_air.overview: This hearing promises to be very difficult for Fatmagül, who comes to the courthouse saying “Let this be the last time” and has to look her enemies in the eye one more time. This time the defendants include Mukaddes, lawyer Münir Telci and Reşat Yaşaran. Will the dark shadows cast over Fatmagül finally be lifted? What will life be like for Fatmagül and Kerim from now on?

name: What is Fatmagul's Fault?
overview: Fatmagul, a simple happy village girl, is violated by 4 drunk rich young men, the extreme hardship she faces forced to marry a rapist and the great remorse felt by others for their inaction when innocence was violated forms the story.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As Fatmagül and Kerim's relationship deepens, the struggle for justice continues. Fatmagül, who confronts her family and her environment, stands up as a strong woman. As Kerim comes to terms with his past, the pressure of the Yasarans increases. A season full of tension, love and revenge locks the viewers to the screen.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Fatmagül grows stronger and continues her fight for justice. Her bond with Kerim deepens as the case against the Yasarans shakes society. Kerim confronts his past, while Fatmagül breaks her silence and reclaims her path. Love, resistance, and the pursuit of justice define this powerful season.
